page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c32g1.32xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 128 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture using Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.9 GHz. The system is equipped with 752.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 5.88 GB of RAM per core. For hardware acceleration, the instance includes four NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPUs with a combined total of 96 GB of VRAM. It does not include any local storage, meaning all storage must be network-attached, but it provides a baseline network bandwidth of 64 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core and memory performance alongside average single-core capabilities. In stress-ng testing, the instance achieved a multi-core CPU performance score of 123,935.69, which is categorized as strong, while its single-core performance of 1,882.5 is average. Memory bandwidth benchmarks show strong results, reaching 6,856.96 GB/sec for cached small-block reads and 253.9 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression performance is in the top tier at 575.13 GB/sec, whereas single-threaded decompression and compression tasks remain in the average tier. The instance also demonstrated strong database and web serving capabilities, with 100.72 million operations per second in Redis SET tests and 61.52 GB/sec of static web serving throughput.

The primary tradeoff of this instance is the complete absence of local storage, requiring reliance on network-attached storage over its 64 Gbps network interface. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of dedicated Intel Xeon cores combined with four NVIDIA A10 GPUs offers a consolidated platform for parallel processing workloads without the overhead of multiple smaller instances. This hardware profile is designed for GPU-accelerated workloads, multi-threaded data processing, large-scale Redis deployments, and high-throughput web serving.
